summary: Tested Additional Photos feature (backend CRUD, gallery HTML) and verified 'Pole Term.' is NOT in underground_types. Backend 6/6 tests passing, frontend Add/Remove flow on Add-Pole form fully works (data-testids present, cyan-accented section visible after OCALC Photos, add/remove/label inputs all functional).
action_items: Minor code quality: /app/backend/models/pole.py defines class AdditionalPhoto twice (lines 7-9 and 39-41). Second definition shadows the first identically. Remove duplicate to keep model file clean.
critical_code_review_comments: Duplicate AdditionalPhoto class declaration in /app/backend/models/pole.py (lines 7-9 and lines 39-41). Both bodies are identical, functionally harmless but indicates a stray edit. Remove one.

/api/poles/{id}/gallery currently grants access whenever no token is supplied (line 419-420 in routes/poles.py: 'has_access = True # Allow public gallery view for now'). This effectively makes the gallery endpoint public - consider tightening this if pole photos are meant to be protected.
Helpers.py pole_photo_items correctly enumerates additional_photos with a fallback label 'Additional N' when label is empty - verified working in gallery HTML test.
seed_data_creation: Test poles created with TEST_AP_POLE_1/2 prefixes; cleaned up via DELETE in fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_additional_photos_and_underground.py covers POST/PUT/GET pole with additional_photos, gallery HTML contains additional photo labels (including 'Additional N' default), and underground_types list excludes 'Pole Term.' / 'Pole Terminal'. Frontend data-testids: add-additional-photo-btn, additional-photo-{i}-label, remove-additional-photo-{i}. Section appears between OCALC Photos and Down Guys with cyan accent. PoleForm.jsx properly initializes additionalPhotos state as [] (no default row) and submits via additional_photos field after filtering empty rows (filter requires ap.photo). NOTE: photo file upload itself wasn't tested via Playwright (PhotoUpload component needs file input), but the schema accepts data:image/* URLs which are accepted on the API side.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found. Feature working as specified.
